scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile wt && if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then codesign -s - --force wt; fi
scripts.build:herdr-plugin: bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile .herdr-plugin/bin/wt && bun build src/herdr-plugin/index.ts --compile --outfile .herdr-plugin/bin/wt-herdr && if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then codesign -s - --force .herdr-plugin/bin/wt .herdr-plugin/bin/wt-herdr; fi
